title: Report suggests Woody Johnson meddled in Aaron Glenn's defensive coordinator plans

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Report suggests Woody Johnson meddled in Aaron Glenn's defensive coordinator plans
sources.description: Longtime assistant coach Wink Martindale interviewed twice in January for the Jets' defensive coordinator position, and a new report says that Martindale heard two different things from head coach Aaron Glenn at those two interviews — perhaps because Jets owner Woody Johnson told Glenn to change his plans for the defense.
